## Plot stress response genes related to IAA synthase, osmolytes, heat shock protein, DNA repair,
# peptidoglycan biosynthesis, osmotic stress, chemotaxis, biofilm formation, oxidative stress, motility


# Obtain the relative abundance for differentially abundant genes
# Calculate the mean relative abundance of each gene in irrigated and non-irrigated groups
```{r}
dd <- read.csv("./Output/Relative_abundance_percent_KO_count.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
dd <- dd[,rownames(design)]

gene_means <- apply(dd, 1, function(x){
  tapply(x, design$Irrigation, mean)
})

t(gene_means)[1:5, ]
gene_means02 <- as.data.frame(t(gene_means))

# There are 68 stress response genes in 'irrigated vs non-irragated_differentially.abundant.csv' files
df <- read.csv("./Data/68_stress_response_genes.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
de <- gene_means02[rownames(df),]
# rename
colnames(de) <- c("mean.irr","mean.nonirr")
dg <- cbind(df, de)

# Up-regulated stress response gene in response to irrigation
dh <- dg[dg$log2FoldChange > 0,]

write.csv(dg, file = "./Output/68_differential_genes_Mean_Rel.abund.csv")

# Export 43 upregulated stress response genes in response to irrigation
write.csv(dh, file = "./Output/43_upregulated_stress_response_genes.csv")
```


# Sankey Plot the stress response pathways/modules enriched under irrigation

# Load packages

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Import data

```{r}
gene_file <- "./Output/43_upregulated_stress_response_genes.csv"
gene_tab <- read_csv(gene_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# 1. Data structure
#    First column：Treatment
#    Second：Classify
#    Flow width：mean.irr / mean.nonirr, refers to relative abundance
# ============================================================

sankey_df <- gene_tab %>%
  mutate(
    Classify = str_trim(as.character(Classify))
  ) %>%
  select(Classify, mean.irr, mean.nonirr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean.irr, mean.nonirr),
    names_to = "mean_group",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      mean_group == "mean.irr" ~ "irrigated",
      mean_group == "mean.nonirr" ~ "non-irrigated"
    ),
    Abundance = as.numeric(Abundance)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Treatment),
    !is.na(Classify),
    !is.na(Abundance),
    Classify != "",
    Abundance > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Classify) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ============================================================
# 2. Set sort order

treatment_order <- c("irrigated", "non-irrigated")

class_order <- sankey_df %>%
  group_by(Classify) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(Classify)

sankey_df <- sankey_df %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_order),
    Classify = factor(Classify, levels = class_order) )

# ============================================================
# 3. Custom Function: Calculate Node Position
#    node_gap_ratio: Control the spacing between the gray boxes
# ============================================================

total_abund <- sum(sankey_df$Abundance)

node_gap_ratio <- 0.02
node_gap <- total_abund * node_gap_ratio

make_nodes <- function(node_total, axis_name, x_pos, gap, max_height) {
  
  node_total <- node_total %>%
    arrange(order)
  
  n_node <- nrow(node_total)
  axis_height <- sum(node_total$value) + gap * max(n_node - 1, 0)
  offset <- (max_height - axis_height) / 2
  
  starts <- c(0, head(cumsum(node_total$value + gap), -1))
  
  node_total %>%
    mutate(
      axis = axis_name,
      x = x_pos,
      ymin = offset + starts,
      ymax = offset + starts + value
    )
}

# Treatment as the start node; Combines the total abundances from the two treatments
treatment_total <- sankey_df %>%
  group_by(node = Treatment) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(order = match(node, treatment_order))

# Classify as the end node
class_total <- sankey_df %>%
  group_by(node = Classify) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(order = match(node, class_order))

height_treatment <- sum(treatment_total$value) +
  node_gap * max(nrow(treatment_total) - 1, 0)

height_class <- sum(class_total$value) +
  node_gap * max(nrow(class_total) - 1, 0)

max_height <- max(height_treatment, height_class)

nodes_treatment <- make_nodes(
  treatment_total,
  axis_name = "Treatment",
  x_pos = 0,
  gap = node_gap,
  max_height = max_height
)

nodes_class <- make_nodes(
  class_total,
  axis_name = "Classify",
  x_pos = 1,
  gap = node_gap,
  max_height = max_height
)

nodes_df <- bind_rows(nodes_treatment, nodes_class)


# ============================================================
# 4. Calculate the upper and lower bounds of each flow in the left and right nodes

flow_df <- sankey_df %>%
  left_join(
    nodes_treatment %>%
      select(Treatment = node, treat_ymin = ymin, treat_ymax = ymax),
    by = "Treatment"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    nodes_class %>%
      select(Classify = node, class_ymin = ymin, class_ymax = ymax),
    by = "Classify"
  )

# The flow position inside the “Treatment” section on the left
flow_df <- flow_df %>%
  arrange(Treatment, Classify) %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    src_ymin = dplyr::first(treat_ymin) + cumsum(dplyr::lag(Abundance, default = 0)),
    src_ymax = src_ymin + Abundance
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# The position of the stream inside “Classify” on the right
flow_df <- flow_df %>%
  arrange(Classify, Treatment) %>%
  group_by(Classify) %>%
  mutate(
    tgt_ymin = dplyr::first(class_ymin) + cumsum(dplyr::lag(Abundance, default = 0)),
    tgt_ymax = tgt_ymin + Abundance
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(flow_id = row_number())


# ============================================================
# 5. Generate Polygons with Smooth Streamlines

node_width <- 0.12

x_src <- 0 + node_width / 2
x_tgt <- 1 - node_width / 2

bezier_curve <- function(x0, y0, x1, y1, n = 80, curvature = 0.55) {
  
  t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n)
  
  cx1 <- x0 + (x1 - x0) * curvature
  cx2 <- x1 - (x1 - x0) * curvature
  
  x <- (1 - t)^3 * x0 +
    3 * (1 - t)^2 * t * cx1 +
    3 * (1 - t) * t^2 * cx2 +
    t^3 * x1
  
  y <- (1 - t)^3 * y0 +
    3 * (1 - t)^2 * t * y0 +
    3 * (1 - t) * t^2 * y1 +
    t^3 * y1
  
  data.frame(x = x, y = y)
}

poly_df <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(flow_df)), function(i) {
    
    r <- flow_df[i, ]
    
    upper <- bezier_curve(
      x0 = x_src,
      y0 = r$src_ymax,
      x1 = x_tgt,
      y1 = r$tgt_ymax
    )
    
    lower <- bezier_curve(
      x0 = x_tgt,
      y0 = r$tgt_ymin,
      x1 = x_src,
      y1 = r$src_ymin
    )
    
    poly <- bind_rows(upper, lower)
    
    poly$flow_id <- r$flow_id
    poly$Treatment <- r$Treatment
    poly$Classify <- r$Classify
    
    poly
  })
)
```


# 6. Sankey plot

```{r}
label_df <- nodes_df %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      axis == "Treatment" ~ as.character(node),
      axis == "Classify" ~ str_wrap(as.character(node), width = 18)
    )
  )


# 6.1. Calculate log2 abundance ratios
contrast_df <- sankey_df %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.character(Treatment),
    Classify = as.character(Classify)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Treatment,
    values_from = Abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = if_else(
      irrigated > 0 & `non-irrigated` > 0,
      log2(irrigated / `non-irrigated`),
      NA_real_
    ),
    FC_label = if_else(
      is.na(log2FC),
      "NA",
      sprintf("%+.2f", log2FC)
    )
  )

# 6.2. Right-side category labels
class_labels <- nodes_class %>%
  mutate(
    Classify = as.character(node),
    y_center = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
    label = stringr::str_wrap(Classify, width = 22)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    contrast_df %>%
      select(Classify, log2FC, FC_label),
    by = "Classify"
  )

# 6.3. Left-side treatment labels
treatment_labels <- nodes_treatment %>%
  mutate(
    label = as.character(node),
    y_center = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  )

# 6.4. Sankey plot
p1 <- ggplot() +
  # Flow polygons
  geom_polygon(data = poly_df, aes(x = x, y = y, group = flow_id, fill = Treatment), alpha = 0.7, color = NA) +
  
  # Left treatment nodes
  geom_rect(data = nodes_treatment,
  aes(
      xmin = x - node_width / 2,
      xmax = x + node_width / 2,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax),
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.35) +
  
  # Right nodes: colored sections for each treatment
  geom_rect(data = flow_df,
    aes(
      xmin = x_tgt,
      xmax = 1 + node_width / 2,
      ymin = tgt_ymin,
      ymax = tgt_ymax,
      fill = Treatment),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.35) +
  
  # Right category boundaries
  geom_rect(data = nodes_class,
    aes(
      xmin = x - node_width / 2,
      xmax = x + node_width / 2,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax),
    fill = NA,
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.35) +
  
  # Left labels
  geom_text(data = treatment_labels, aes(x = x, y = y_center, label = label), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  
  # Right category labels
  geom_text(data = class_labels, aes(x= 1.10, y= y_center, label= label), 
    hjust = 0, size = 3.4, lineheight = 0.9) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.18, 2.02), expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,  fill = "Treatment") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(25, 20, 15, 20))


p1
ggsave(filename = "./Output/Stress_response_gene_pathways_Sankey.pdf", p1, width = 6.5, height = 7)
```


# Plot the stress response genes enriched under irrigation

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cols4all)

df <- read.csv("./Output/43_upregulated_stress_response_genes.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
colnames(df)
df <- df[df$log2FoldChange > 0,]

theme_set(theme_bw())
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = reorder(Gene.name,`log2FoldChange`), fill = `log2FoldChange`)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.64), breaks = seq(0, 0.64, 0.2))
p1

p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = `log2FoldChange`, y = reorder(Gene.name,`log2FoldChange`))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.15, fill = 'black') +    # width of column
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.64), breaks = seq(0, 0.64, 0.2)) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 15, colour = "black")) + ylab("")

p2

p3 <- p2 + geom_point(aes(size = mean.irr, color = Classify)) +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) # bubble size

p3
ggsave("./Output/Stress_responses_genes.pdf", p3, width = 8, height = 8)
```
